senses.gloss:
अञ्च् 1. अञ्च् (connected with अच्, q. v.),
cl. 1. P. A. अञ्चति, -ते, आनञ्च, -ए, अञ्चि-
ष्यति, -ते, अञ्चितुम्, to bend, curve, incline, curl;
to reverence (with inclined body), to honour; to tend,
move, go, wander about; to request: cl. 10. or Caus.
अञ्चयति, -यितुम्, to unfold, make clear, produce:
Desid. P. A. अञ्चिचिषति, -ते, to be desirous of bend-
ing: Pass. अञ्च्यते or अच्यते, to be bent.

2. अञ्च् (at the end of compounds), turned to, going
or directed towards; see अकुध्र्यञ्च्, अवाञ्च्, उदञ्च्,
देवद्र्यञ्च्, &c. It may also mean honouring, see
प्राञ्च्.

आञ्च् आञ्च् (आ-अञ्च्), cl. 1. P. A. आञ्चति, -ते,
-चितुम्, to bend, crook, curve.

अञ्च, अस्, m. (only used as the last part of com-
pound words), curling, as in रोमाञ्च, sensation of
the hairs of the body curling, thrill of rapture.
अञ्चति, इस्, m. or अञ्चती, f. wind; fire.
अञ्चन, अम्, n. act of bending or curving.

आञ्चन, अम्, n. partial extraction of thorns or
arrows and the like from the body.

अञ्चल, अस्, m. (perhaps also अम्), n. the border or
corner of a garment, especially of a woman's garment,
of a veil, shawl. (In Bengālī, a strip of country,
district.)

अञ्चित, अस्, आ, अम्, bent, curved, curled, arched,
handsome; gone, walked in; reverenced, honoured,
distinguished.
—अञ्चित-पत्त्र, अस्, m. lotus with
curved leaves.
—अञ्चितपत्त्राक्ष (˚र-अक्ष), अस्,
ई, अम्, having lotus eyes.
—अञ्चित-भ्रू, ऊस्, f. wo-
man with arched or handsome eyebrows.
—अञ्चित-
लाङ्गूल, अस्, आ, अम्, having a curved tail (as a
monkey).
